name: skip-wait-public
description: Chrome extension to skip wait timers, bypass countdowns, and clear URL shortener and waiting-page delays. FastForward and Universal Bypass alternative.

paragraphs: Skip Wait is a Chrome extension that skips wait timers, bypasses countdowns, and clears link shortener and waiting page delays on supported sites. If a page still asks you to wait or click Continue, Skip Wait finishes those steps, then opens the destination or download.
5 free bypasses each day with no key. For unlimited use: $5 per 2 months on EAS Store, then activate the key in the popup.

Skip Wait is a FastForward and Universal Bypass alternative. It is not FastForward or Universal Bypass. It runs only on matching pages—other sites stay unchanged. No paste tool and no site-by-site setup.
features: Skip wait and skip countdown on delay and download-timer pages
Countdown bypass and bypass timers on please-wait screens
Clear download, preparing, and trial-ready timers when the host allows it
Link shortener bypass on URL shorteners and short-link chains
Skip waiting pages, safelink waits, landing waits, and multi-step unlock hops

whatItDoes.text: Skip Wait is a Chrome extension that skips wait timers, bypasses countdowns, and clears link shortener and waiting page delays on supported sites. If a page still asks you to wait or click Continue, Skip Wait finishes those steps, then opens the destination or download.
